codes.title: Boot completed
codes.explanation: A new boot started, including wake from deep sleep. This is history rather than a current fault.
codes.recovery: No action is needed for normal wakes. Inspect reset events if restarts are unexpected.

codes.title: Filesystem mutex creation failed
codes.explanation: The shared filesystem lock could not be created. Concurrent storage access cannot safely continue.
codes.recovery: Keep the device powered for diagnostics; inspect memory use and restart after addressing the cause.

codes.title: Networking task creation failed
codes.explanation: The networking task could not be started, so uploads cannot run.
codes.recovery: Inspect available memory and task configuration; recording may continue locally.

codes.title: Watchdog reset detected
codes.explanation: The previous run stopped servicing a watchdog and was reset. This record is created on the next boot.
codes.recovery: Inspect the preceding journal and task timing; repeated resets need a firmware investigation.

codes.title: Brownout reset detected
codes.explanation: The previous run reset because supply voltage fell too low.
codes.recovery: Check the USB supply, cable and battery before relying on recording.

codes.title: Panic reset detected
codes.explanation: The previous run ended in a panic. Raw crash text is deliberately excluded from diagnostic context.
codes.recovery: Inspect a private serial trace and the firmware build; verify recording after restart.

codes.title: Persistent identity state unavailable
codes.explanation: The diagnostic boot counter could not be read or saved. Random boot IDs still identify records.
codes.recovery: Inspect NVS health; do not infer boot order from the failed counter.

codes.title: Network task stack margin low
codes.explanation: The networking task has little measured stack headroom and may fail on a larger upload.
codes.recovery: Measure stack use on hardware and adjust task sizing before road use.

codes.title: Power management initialization failed
codes.explanation: The power-management chip could not be initialized. Battery and peripheral power controls are unreliable.
codes.recovery: Check the board variant, power and I2C wiring; do not assume charging or rail control works.

codes.title: Battery charge is low
codes.explanation: The measured battery voltage crossed the configured low threshold.
codes.recovery: Connect a suitable supply and check battery condition if this recurs.

codes.title: Battery charge is critical
codes.explanation: The battery voltage crossed the critical threshold; safe recording time is limited.
codes.recovery: Restore external power and let the device close files before it sleeps.

codes.title: Charging paused for high temperature
codes.explanation: The charge guard paused charging because its temperature estimate is too high. This is not a calibrated cell-temperature measurement.
codes.recovery: Let the device cool and check its placement. Charging resumes only when the guard permits it.

codes.title: Charging paused for low temperature
codes.explanation: The charge guard paused charging because its temperature estimate is too low.
codes.recovery: Move the device into a suitable temperature range and wait for the guard to permit charging.

codes.title: Charge temperature unavailable
codes.explanation: The charge guard cannot obtain a usable temperature reading and cannot safely permit charging.
codes.recovery: Inspect sensor readings and power management; do not bypass the charge guard.

codes.title: PMU startup needed recovery or retries
codes.explanation: The PMU/RTC I2C bus needed recovery or PMU startup needed another attempt. This boot history also records unsuccessful startup; PMU_INIT_FAILED describes the continuing failure.
codes.recovery: Inspect repeated occurrences for PMU/RTC wiring, power or unexpected resets. Check pmu_ready before assuming startup succeeded.

codes.title: No GPS serial data
codes.explanation: No usable GPS serial data arrived within the configured interval.
codes.recovery: Check GPS power, UART pins and board selection; recording needs a working GPS stream.

codes.title: GPS has no position fix
codes.explanation: GPS data is arriving but no acceptable position fix is available.
codes.recovery: Allow time with a clear sky view and check the antenna if the condition persists.

codes.title: GPS rejected configuration
codes.explanation: The GPS returned a negative acknowledgment for a configuration message.
codes.recovery: Check the receiver model and supported configuration; some defaults may remain active.

codes.title: GPS configuration acknowledgment timed out
codes.explanation: No acknowledgment arrived before the configuration timeout.
codes.recovery: Check UART traffic and receiver compatibility; verify the settings actually in use.

codes.title: Position fix lost during a trip
codes.explanation: A trip is active but acceptable GPS positions stopped. Distance across the gap may be underestimated.
codes.recovery: Restore sky view and inspect the antenna if recurring; review the trip gap later.

codes.title: Usable UTC time unavailable
codes.explanation: No trusted UTC clock is available. Uptime still orders diagnostic events within this boot.
codes.recovery: Wait for GPS or a permitted time sync; do not use these device timestamps for liveness.

codes.title: Real-time clock unavailable
codes.explanation: The external real-time clock did not respond or could not be initialized.
codes.recovery: Check the board variant and RTC bus; GPS or network time may still become available.

codes.title: Real-time clock value invalid
codes.explanation: The RTC was readable but its time cannot be trusted, for example after power loss.
codes.recovery: Acquire trusted GPS or network time before updating the RTC.

codes.title: SD storage unavailable
codes.explanation: The SD card could not be mounted or used. Recording may fall back to internal flash.
codes.recovery: Check the card and its power rail; preserve existing files before repair or replacement.

codes.title: LittleFS storage unavailable
codes.explanation: Internal flash storage could not be mounted or used.
codes.recovery: Preserve data and inspect the partition; never format automatically on a mount failure.

codes.title: No recording storage available
codes.explanation: Neither recording backend is usable. The degraded service loop can report the failure but cannot record trips.
codes.recovery: Restore a usable storage backend and verify a test trip before relying on the tracker.

codes.title: Recording storage is low
codes.explanation: Available recording space is below the configured reserve.
codes.recovery: Upload pending trips and inspect retention; preserve unuploaded trips.

codes.title: Recording storage is full
codes.explanation: There is insufficient usable space for recording safely.
codes.recovery: Upload and verify stored trips before reclaiming space; check diagnostic quota enforcement.

codes.title: Trip file write failed
codes.explanation: A trip file operation failed. Some points may be missing or the trip may need recovery.
codes.recovery: Check storage health and space; preserve the partial trip for recovery.

codes.title: Incomplete trip recovery failed
codes.explanation: A partial trip could not be recovered safely.
codes.recovery: Preserve the original file and inspect it with recovery tooling before deletion.

codes.title: Diagnostic journal write failed
codes.explanation: A diagnostic record or acknowledgment could not be persisted. The fallback queue may still hold it.
codes.recovery: Check diagnostic storage and space; inspect dropped-event counts for loss.

codes.title: Diagnostic events were dropped
codes.explanation: The bounded journal or fallback queue discarded records. Trip files are not deleted to make diagnostic space.
codes.recovery: Restore storage or upload the backlog; use the dropped count to identify incomplete history.

codes.title: Incomplete trip recovered
codes.explanation: A partial trip was recovered after interruption.
codes.recovery: Review the recovered trip if the interruption may have lost points.

codes.title: Home access point not seen
codes.explanation: The configured home access point was absent from a scan. Each scan increments a boot-local check-in counter; it does not create a journal event.
codes.recovery: No action is usually needed away from home; uploads wait until the configured network is available.

codes.title: WiFi association failed
codes.explanation: The configured access point was seen but the device could not join it.
codes.recovery: Check network availability and credentials privately; credentials and network names are never event context.

codes.title: Upload transport failed
codes.explanation: An upload failed before a usable HTTP response, such as a timeout or connection loss.
codes.recovery: Check connectivity and retry later; retain data until an exact acknowledgment arrives.

codes.title: Upload authentication failed
codes.explanation: The server rejected upload authentication.
codes.recovery: Check the configured bearer token privately and back off retries.

codes.title: Upload exceeded server limit
codes.explanation: The server rejected the request size. Diagnostic batches can shrink; trip splitting is a separate feature.
codes.recovery: Reduce the diagnostic batch or check trip split limits; retain the rejected data.

codes.title: Upload payload invalid
codes.explanation: The server rejected the upload schema or content.
codes.recovery: Isolate the offending record and inspect protocol compatibility without logging raw bodies.

codes.title: Upload identity conflict
codes.explanation: The server already has the same record identity with different content.
codes.recovery: Isolate the conflicting record and investigate identity or persistence logic; never overwrite silently.

codes.title: Upload server failed
codes.explanation: The server returned a retryable server error.
codes.recovery: Retain queued data and retry with backoff after checking server health.

codes.title: Unexpected upload HTTP status
codes.explanation: The server returned an HTTP status outside the specifically handled cases.
codes.recovery: Inspect the status and server configuration; retain unacknowledged data.

codes.title: Diagnostic acknowledgment invalid
codes.explanation: The response did not acknowledge exactly the submitted event identities.
codes.recovery: Retain the batch and inspect server compatibility; do not advance acknowledgment metadata.

codes.title: OLED display unavailable
codes.explanation: The OLED could not be initialized or updated. Logging and networking continue independently.
codes.recovery: Check display power, address and wiring; use the server health page meanwhile.

codes.title: Device has not contacted the server
codes.explanation: Server receipt time is older than the configured silence threshold. This condition is derived by the monitor, not proof of a device failure.
codes.recovery: Check whether the vehicle has been used, network coverage and device power before investigating hardware.
